text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
And so, the day is finally here!
The 1st Stage of the U.A.F. Qualifiers!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: At venues across the nation today, athlete Umamusume push their physical limits in competition!!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Who will shine brilliantly
in this momentous first preliminary match!?
Don't miss the upcoming stream!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having made thorough preparations,
we arrived at the preliminary tournament venue and—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: How are both of you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—
That is wonderful to hear.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: As for Elfie, she's at a different venue for the qualifiers today, so I have a message from her.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"I'll see you on the next stage!"
...is what she said.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks to everyone's support, so many athlete
Umamusume have participated in this 1st stage.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
What kind of tournament will it turn out to be...?
Speaking for myself, I'm very much looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
I pray that <chrname>-san
will be able to do her very best.
Good luck out there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Holding that encouragement close to heart—
it was time to take on the first preliminary tournament!"
